newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony shares hit new high.
newsitem.headline: Sony shares hit new high.

text.p: Shares of electronics giant Sony Corp hit an all-time high on Friday, partly helped by an extended record run on Wall Street overnight, traders said.
The share price briefly hit a record high of 11,000 yen, breaking the previous high of 10,900 yen marked on July 18. As of 0147 GMT, it stood 100 yen higher at 10,900.

UBS Securities Ltd said in a recent report that Sony's group net profits for the first quarter of 1997/98 are expected to rise by 35 percent, also supporting the shares, traders said. Its earnings for the quarter are due on July 31.
